newsitem.title: USA: Westcoast in delivery pact with Nova Scotia.
newsitem.headline: Westcoast in delivery pact with Nova Scotia.

text.p: Westcoast Energy Inc said Friday that its Maritimes & Northeast Pipeline Ltd Partnership has a precedent agreement to deliver natural gas to Nova Scotia Power Inc.
Under the pact, Nova Scotia Power has agreed to contract capacity of 90,000 million British thermal units per day (mmBtu/d), Westcoast said.

"We anticipate further precedent agreements to be signed in the near future, as the Maritime market develops," Maritimes & Northeast Pipeline president Pat Langan said in a release from the company. "These precedent agreements are significant first steps in the establishment of natural gas markets in Nova Scotia and New Brunswick," he added.
The company said the satisfaction of all terms of the pact should enable the Maritimes & Northeast Pipeline to provide natural gas transportation service by November 1, 1999.

Operating with an initial capacity of 530,000 mmBtu/d, the proposed underground pipeline will serve Nova Scotia, New Brunswick and New England markets before interconnecting with the North American pipeline grid near Dracut, Massachusetts.
